about: PoE2 1.0 PREVIEW gems (announced for the 11 Dec 2026 release; every number '1.0 preview, subject to change'). Read only when a request sets preview_1_0 (builder/preview/__init__.py). Numbers are poe2db's reveal pages (GGG's 1.0 reveal site, not a client datamine), shown at ONE gem level each; other levels follow a 0.5.5 attack's level curve (curve_reference, LOW). 'model' is what builder/preview/lua.py writes into PoB; 'not_modelled' lists each part of the skill left out (an UNDERCOUNT unless it says otherwise). Release day: replace this file with the re-exported game data and PoB's update (builder/preview/PLAN.md, 'Release day').

curve_reference.why: The 109 PoB-PoE2 attacks with damage at levels 1, 13, 20, 21 and 40 fall in three level curves: level 20 / level 13 damage 1.27-1.42 (the median, 1.412), ~1.54 and ~1.64. Lightning Spear's 1.406 is the median family. A gem shown at level 13 is scaled by the reference's damage and cost ratio at each level; one shown at level 20 is scaled only above or below 20. LOW: 1.0's own curves are unpublished (checked: poe2db pages show one level; RESEARCH53 R53-1 'Searched, found nothing': per-level gem tables). Rows either side: a level-20 gem shown at 13 reads x1.54 / x1.64 on the other two curves (+9% / +16% over the reference).

gems.name: Charged Slash
gems.description: Slash in front of you for Shocking Hits; from Ready Stance a spinning slash with chaining lightning Projectiles (1.0 preview).
not_modelled: Ready Stance's spin (60% attack speed, 133%, 2 more hits dual wielding at 20% less) and its 5 chaining Projectiles (129%, all Lightning, chain 3): an UNDERCOUNT for a build that plays from Ready Stance (Stances are the next mechanic; the search will pick the stance as a play strategy)
charging Buried Blades on Hit (Earthrend's blades)
'Projectile' is left off the slash's skill types so projectile supports don't apply to the melee slash in PoB (the projectiles aren't modelled yet)
sources: https://poe2db.tw/us/Charged_Slash (read 23 Nov 2026: Level 13, tier 1, 18 Mana, Attack Speed 115% of base, Attack Damage 133%, req level 52 / 51 Str / 51 Dex, One or Two Hand Sword; 75% Physical to Lightning, 325% more chance to Shock, dual wielding 30% less damage per separate hit)

gems.name: Elemental Penetration
gems.description: Supports any skill that Hits enemies, making those Hits Penetrate enemy Elemental resistances (1.0 preview).
assumptions: Whether Fire / Cold / Lightning Penetration stay in 1.0 is UNVERIFIED (RESEARCH53 R53-1 D; third parties say they merge). They are NOT dropped (CLAUDE.md: never drop on an unverified claim); instead Elemental Penetration shares their three support families, so a skill takes at most one of the four and the 30% never stacks with a single-element one (the merge reading; no overcount either way)
requirements and support types as Cold Penetration's today (Damage, Attack or Crossbow Ammo skills); tier 2 as the single-element ones (UNVERIFIED)
sources: https://poe2db.tw/us/Elemental_Penetration (read 23 Nov 2026: support, Cost Multiplier 120%, +5 Int; 'Supported Skills Penetrate 30% of Enemy Elemental Resistances')
